explained_output: XGBoost raw margin (log-odds), before sigmoid calibration
local_example_selection: Highest sigmoid-calibrated fraud probabilities in the sampled validation dataset.
notes: Only validation data was used for explanations.
The reserved test period was not used.
SHAP values explain model raw margins rather than calibrated probability differences.
SHAP associations describe model behavior, not causal proof that a transaction is fraudulent.
